title: Testing for Reliability: Load & Chaos — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces the Step-by-Step Chaos Experiment Lifecycle: hypothesis verification, baseline measurement, fault injection, resilience observation, and automated cleanup.
routing_rationale: A structured chaos experiment must always establish a steady-state hypothesis before introducing chaos to mathematically verify that the system self-heals.

nodes.label: Verify Steady State
nodes.detail: Validates that production SLO is healthy before beginning chaos experiment.

nodes.label: Inject 300ms Delay
nodes.detail: Emulates cross-region WAN degradation between app service and inventory service.

nodes.label: Envoy Circuit Breaker
nodes.detail: Shunts traffic to fallback cached inventory response in 2ms.

nodes.label: Experiment Complete & Cleaned
nodes.detail: Removes chaos injection; verifies system recovers to steady-state within 30 seconds.

steps.title: Hypothesis Confirmation
steps.action: Validates steady-state; injects 300ms network delay into inventory service.
steps.why_traversal: Ensures experiment tests a specific resilience hypothesis.

steps.title: Circuit Breaker Shunting
steps.action: Envoy proxy trips circuit breaker and returns cached catalog data.
steps.why_traversal: Confirms user experience is shielded from downstream latency.

steps.title: Cleanup & Verification
steps.action: Chaos controller deletes fault CRD; telemetry confirms p99 returns to < 200ms.
steps.why_traversal: Leaves zero lingering synthetic defects in production.

scenarios.label: Zombie Chaos CRD Lingers in Production
scenarios.root_cause: CI runner crashed mid-experiment, leaving NetworkChaos CRD running indefinitely.
scenarios.blast_radius: Customers experience sluggish checkout for 8 hours.
scenarios.recovery: Add automated TTL expiration directly in Chaos Mesh CRD spec so faults self-terminate.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Traces the Step-by-Step Chaos Experiment Lifecycle: hypothesis verification, baseline measurement, fault injection, resilience observation, and automated cleanup.
